about_section.a_free_app_for_flight_sim: A free app for flight-sim pilots — no ads, accounts or subscriptions.
about_section.the_app_checks_for_new_ver: The app checks for new versions by itself and installs them — no manual downloads.
airbus.a_thr_is_on_the_simulator: A/THR is on — the simulator may move the thrust itself.
airbus.turn_a_knob_with_your_finger: Turn a knob with your finger: the edge for big steps, the centre for small ones. A tap = PUSH. Tap the digits to type a value.
autopilots.turn_a_knob_with_your_finger: Turn a knob with your finger: the outer ring moves in big steps, the centre in small ones. Tap the window to type a value.
b787.turn_a_knob_the_edge_for: Turn a knob: the edge for big steps, the centre for small ones. HDG: tap the knob for HDG SEL. Roll the V/S wheel with a finger. Tap the digits to type a value.
boeing737.turn_a_knob_the_edge_for: Turn a knob: the edge for big steps, the centre for small ones. Roll the V/S wheel up (DN) or down (UP). Tap the digits to type a value.
brake_controls.wheel_brakes_axis_springs: Wheel brakes axis — springs back on release
briefing.built_from_the_metar_read_in: Built from the METAR, read in English
briefing.freezing_precipitation_risk_of_: Freezing precipitation — risk of airframe icing.
briefing.headwind_tailwind_from_the_righ: ↓ headwind, ↑ tailwind, → from the right, ← from the left (kt). True directions.
briefing.is_not_in_the_ourairports_datab: {0} is not in the OurAirports database.
briefing.no_frequencies_in_the_database_: No frequencies in the database. On VATSIM and IVAO check active controllers on the network map.
briefing.ourairports_has_no_runway_data_: OurAirports has no runway data for this airport.
briefing.tap_a_frequency_to_copy_it: Tap a frequency to copy it.
briefing.tap_a_frequency_to_set_it: Tap a frequency to set it in the aircraft radio.
briefing.temperature_equals_dew_point_fo: Temperature equals dew point — fog possible.
briefing.temperature_near_0_c_with_high: Temperature near 0 °C with high humidity — icing possible.
briefing.this_airport_does_not_issue_a: This airport does not issue a TAF.
briefing.this_airport_does_not_issue_wea: This airport does not issue weather reports. Check nearby airports in the Nearby section.
briefing.thunderstorm_or_cumulonimbus_ne: Thunderstorm or cumulonimbus near the airport.
briefing.weather_not_loaded_pull_to_refr: Weather not loaded ({0}). Pull to refresh or check your connection.
briefing_extras.direction_speed_in_knots: Direction/speed in knots and temperature in °C. Flight level derived from geopotential height (Open-Meteo model); the last row is the freezing level.
briefing_extras.ils_frequencies_come_fro: ILS frequencies come from the MSFS 2024 database. Connect to OpenTakeoff Link — the data is saved on the phone and available without the simulator.
briefing_extras.loading_airport_data_fro: Loading airport data from the MSFS database…
briefing_extras.no_valid_sigmets_within_: No valid SIGMETs within 50 NM and no pilot reports nearby.
briefing_extras.the_msfs_database_has_no: The MSFS database has no ILS for this airport (add-on airports can be incomplete).
charts.faa_publishes_no_charts_for_this: FAA publishes no charts for this airport.
charts.new_cycle_charts_may_be_outdated: New cycle {0} — charts may be outdated
charts.official_faa_charts_airport_diagr: Official FAA charts: airport diagram, approaches, SIDs, STARs, minimums. The chart catalogue takes about 2.5 MB (about 16 MB to download). Chart PDFs download when opened and then work offline.
charts.source_faa_d_tpp_real_world: Source: FAA d-TPP. Real-world charts — may differ from the MSFS navigation database.
checklists.aircraft_not_recognised_pick_: Aircraft not recognised. Pick checklists manually:
cockpit.add_a_marker_to_the_flight: Add a marker to the flight recording
cockpit.hold_the_button_and_slide_your: Hold the button and slide your finger: sideways to look left and right, up and down to look up and down.
cockpit.hold_the_button_and_tilt_the: Hold the button and tilt the phone: sideways to look left and right, towards or away from you to look up and down.
cockpit.on_the_pc_the_msfs_window: On the PC the MSFS window must be active (click it once). Set the turning speed in OpenTakeoff Link.
cockpit.switch_between_the_cockpit_and_t: Switch between the cockpit and the outside view with the button next to it.
cockpit.the_camera_turns_in_whatever_vie: The camera turns in whatever view the simulator is in now — like the pilot's head in the cockpit, around the aircraft outside. Let go and it returns to straight ahead.
cockpit.the_flight_goes_to_the_logbook: The flight goes to the logbook. A new recording starts by itself after landing, or when you resume it (tap REC).
cockpit.view_cockpit_switch_to_the_outsi: View: cockpit. Switch to the outside view
common.a_t_is_on_the_simulator: A/T is on — the simulator may move the thrust levers itself.
common.retract_the_gear_on_the_ground: Retract the gear on the ground?
common.the_aircraft_is_on_the_ground: The aircraft is on the ground. Retracting the gear may damage it in the simulator.
e190.heading_knob_tap_syncs_to_the: Heading knob {0} — tap syncs to the current heading
e190.turn_a_knob_the_edge_for: Turn a knob: the edge for big steps, the centre for small ones. HDG SEL: a tap syncs to the current heading. Tap the digits to type a value.
engine.autothrottle_is_on_the_simulator_: Autothrottle is on — the simulator may move the thrust levers itself.
engine.drag_a_handle_up_or_down: Drag a handle up or down.
engine.each_lever_sets_one_engine_the: Each lever sets one engine. The shared lever next to the displays sets all of them at once.
faa_charts.could_not_read_the_d_tpp: Could not read the d-TPP metafile:
feedback_ui.couldn_t_send_check_your_con: Couldn't send. Check your connection and try again.

feedback_ui.only_if_you_d_like_a: Only if you'd like a reply
feedback_ui.please_describe_it_in_a_few: Please describe it in a few words.

feedback_ui.thank_you_your_report_was_se: Thank you! Your report was sent.
feedback_ui.the_app_recently_stopped_bec: The app recently stopped because of an error. Send a report to the developer? It contains the error details, app version and device model – none of your data.
feedback_ui.what_happened_what_were_you_: What happened? What were you doing right before?
feedback_ui.what_is_missing_or_could_wor: What is missing or could work better?
flight_analysis.at_least_3_touchdowns_ea: At least 3 touchdowns, each scoring 60 or more.
flight_analysis.compared_with_better_in_: Compared with {0}: better in {1}, worse in {2} {3}.
flight_analysis.keep_a_3_path_about_300: Keep a 3° path: about 300 ft per mile to the threshold, vertical speed ≈ 5 × GS.
flight_analysis.keep_control_inputs_smal: Keep control inputs small and smooth; trim after every speed or power change.
flight_analysis.landing_at_another_airpo: Landing at another airport, climbing at least 3000 ft, smooth handling.
flight_analysis.no_bank_data_recorded_ra: No bank data recorded — rated from vertical speed only.
flight_analysis.pick_an_aiming_point_100: Pick an aiming point 1000 ft past the threshold and keep it fixed in the windscreen.
flight_analysis.set_the_approach_configu: Set the approach configuration and speed before 1000 ft; make small, early power corrections.
flight_analysis.sink_rate_up_to_ft_min: Sink rate up to {0} ft/min on final.
flight_analysis.stable_from_1000_ft_2_5: Stable from 1000 ft, 2.5–3.5° path, touchdown in the zone.
flight_analysis.stable_only_from_ft_1000: Stable only from {0} ft (1000 ft recommended in IMC).
flight_analysis.start_the_flare_earlier_: Start the flare earlier (about 20–30 ft) and reduce the sink gradually instead of pulling just above the runway.
flight_analysis.take_off_and_landing_at_: Take-off and landing at the same airport, pattern height 600–1500 ft, up to 20 min.
flight_analysis.the_previous_flight_on_t: the previous flight on this route
flight_analysis.unstable_below_500_ft_st: Unstable below 500 ft (stable from {0} ft) — airlines would require a go-around.
flight_analysis.use_the_rudder_in_the_fl: Use the rudder in the flare to stay on the centreline.
flight_analysis.vertical_speed_jumps_aro: Vertical speed jumps around — trim and fly more gently.
flight_detail.no_touchdown_data_the_flig: No touchdown data (the flight ended in the air or was recorded by an older version).
flight_link_service.the_track_keeps_reco: The track keeps recording in the background
flight_replay.not_enough_track_points_to: Not enough track points to replay.
flight_review.no_earlier_flight_on_this_: No earlier flight on this route, to this airport or in this aircraft.
flight_review.pick_an_exercise_to_check_: Pick an exercise to check the flight against its criteria. The choice is saved with the flight.
flight_review.the_track_is_too_sparse_a: The track is too sparse (a point every 1–3 s is needed) or was recorded by an older version.

Gyro control: hold and tilt the phone; drag down or up to trim
floating_control.handle_drag_to_move_the: Handle: drag to move the button
floating_control.stick_hold_and_move_you: Stick: hold and move your thumb
home.airport_database_not_downloaded_che: Airport database not downloaded: {0}. Check your internet connection.

home.no_such_airport_in_the_database: No such airport in the database

home.the_airport_database_is_still_loadi: The airport database is still loading.
home.the_first_launch_downloads_about_15: The first launch downloads about 15 MB of airport data. After that the app uses the copy on the phone.
home.the_nearest_airports_with_current_w: The nearest airports with current weather, based on the phone's approximate location.
home.weather_noaa_aviation_weather_cente: Weather: NOAA Aviation Weather Center. Airports: OurAirports. For flight simulation only — not for real-world navigation.
